_comment: Hardcoded collaboration threads for challenge 02. Each thread is tied to a specific field, distinguishes internal vs client-visible messages, and tracks who owns the next action. One CPA (Camila), one client (Carlos/Maria Martinez), one colleague (Marcus).

messages.author: Camila Ceal
messages.body: Last digit on the property tax photo is unreadable — could be 6,150 or 6,158. Need a clearer copy before we can lock Schedule A line 5b.

messages.author: Camila Ceal
messages.body: Hi Carlos — the property tax bill photo came through a little blurry on the total line. Could you send a clearer picture or the PDF from the county site when you get a chance? Thank you!

messages.author: Carlos Martinez
messages.body: Sure, I'll grab a better photo tonight and send it over.

messages.author: Camila Ceal
messages.body: Chase sent an original ($2,847.13) and a corrected ($3,112.40) 1099-INT. Planning to use the corrected one — it's dated later and has the CORRECTED box checked. Agree?

messages.author: Marcus Reyes
messages.body: Agreed — corrected supersedes. Just note it in the workpapers in case the client asks why it changed from last year.

messages.author: Camila Ceal
messages.body: Hi Carlos — you listed 12% of the home as used exclusively for business. Can you confirm that's the dedicated office space only (not shared rooms)? Want to make sure we claim this correctly.
